data.name: ImportSubtitle
data.value: Upload CSV or Excel data, validate every row, preview the batch, and confirm a transactional import.

data.name: DashboardImportSubtitle
data.value: Validate and import school data from CSV or Excel files.

data.name: FileRules
data.value: CSV and XLSX are supported. Maximum 5 MiB, 10,000 data rows and 100 columns.

data.name: PreviewLimit
data.value: The preview shows up to the first 100 data rows.

data.name: ConfirmHelp
data.value: Confirmation revalidates current school data and applies the complete batch in one transaction.

data.name: SuccessUploaded
data.value: The file was parsed and validation is complete.

data.name: TeacherImportNote
data.value: Teacher import creates assignments for existing Teacher accounts. It does not create login accounts.

data.name: ResultImportNote
data.value: Assessment results use one row for each assessment question.

data.name: MappingImportNote
data.value: Curriculum mappings require a Draft assessment and an active adopted outcome.

data.name: IdempotencyNote
data.value: Uploading the same file again for the same user and import type returns the existing batch.

data.name: ErrorAccessDenied
data.value: You are not allowed to perform this import.

data.name: ErrorSchoolNotActive
data.value: Imports are unavailable while the school is not active.

data.name: ErrorUnsupportedFile
data.value: Only CSV and XLSX files are supported.

data.name: ErrorInvalidFile
data.value: The uploaded file could not be parsed.

data.name: ErrorFileTooLarge
data.value: The uploaded file exceeds the allowed size.

data.name: ErrorTooManyRows
data.value: The file contains too many data rows.

data.name: ErrorTooManyColumns
data.value: The file contains too many columns.

data.name: ErrorDuplicateHeader
data.value: The file contains duplicate column headers.

data.name: ErrorEmptyFile
data.value: The uploaded file contains no import data.

data.name: ErrorBatchNotFound
data.value: The import batch was not found.

data.name: ErrorBatchHasErrors
data.value: A batch with validation errors cannot be confirmed.

data.name: ErrorBatchStateChanged
data.value: School data changed after validation. Review the updated validation errors.

data.name: ErrorConcurrencyConflict
data.value: This import batch changed in another request. Reload and try again.

data.name: ErrorPersistence
data.value: The import could not be saved.

data.name: ValidationInvalidType
data.value: The value has an invalid format or length.

data.name: ValidationDuplicateRow
data.value: The file contains a duplicate logical row.

data.name: ValidationUnknownReference
data.value: A referenced school record was not found.

data.name: ValidationAmbiguousReference
data.value: The reference matches more than one eligible record.

data.name: ValidationInvalidScore
data.value: The score is outside the allowed question range.

data.name: ValidationExistingConflict
data.value: The row conflicts with an existing record.

data.name: ValidationCrossSchoolReference
data.value: The referenced student is not enrolled in the required class and academic year.

data.name: ValidationAccessDenied
data.value: The teacher is not assigned to the assessment class and subject.

data.name: ValidationIncompleteResult
data.value: Every assessment question must occur exactly once for this student result.

data.name: ErrorSeatLimitReached
data.value: The student import would exceed the committed student-seat limit.
